format: pg_dump custom (-Fc), tables Job and JobChunk
change: Two steps over the base snapshot, both with the artifact's own commands: (1) `embeddings:reembed` re-embedded every JobChunk in place with multilingual-e5-base (chunk ids, texts and job rows unchanged; HNSW index rebuilt); (2) `jobs:clean-salaries` applied the plausible-salary rule now used at ingestion (annual USD within 10,000-1,000,000 and min <= max, otherwise not stated) to 12 jobs, in Postgres and in the salary payload of both Qdrant collections.

same_corpus_check.query: SELECT md5(string_agg(id || md5("chunkText"), ',' ORDER BY id)) FROM "JobChunk"

embedding_model: intfloat/multilingual-e5-base (768 dimensions, local embedding-server, CUDA on an RTX 3060, fp32)

qdrant.eval_job_chunks: multilingual-e5-base vectors, backfilled from this database (4013/4013 indexed)
qdrant.eval_job_chunks_e5base: e5-base-v2 vectors copied before re-embedding, for the embedding-model ablation (4013/4013 indexed; exact top-10 identical to pgvector on 20 queries)

parity: ann:quick (200 title queries): Qdrant exact vs pgvector exact recall@10 = 0.9975 (ties between identical chunks)
restore: createdb <db>; CREATE EXTENSION vector; pg_restore --no-owner -d <db> corpus-2026-10-14-clean.dump (verified 14-oct: 1068 jobs, 4013 chunks, same text fingerprint as the base snapshot, 493 jobs with salary)
